taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "1-3 dm. high".

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: a shrub.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "Low densely branched shrub".

traits.leaf_habit.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 327, Vaccinium: key: "Leaves not coriaceous, deciduous" (section Euvaccinium).

traits.clonal.note: Spreading in low, continuous patches over meadow slopes, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 93890682, 307832590, 4882217, 94886221, 306569656, 16293761, 385558788, 57549521): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "Leaves obovate or rarely broadly elliptic".

traits.leaf_apex.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: leaves "acutish or acute at the apex".

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: leaves "mostly cuneate at the base".

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: leaves "distinctly crenately serrulate above the middle".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: leaves "15-35 mm. long".

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium deliciosum: "Leaf blades usually glaucous, obovate, oblanceolate, or, rarely, elliptic, 17-35 x 9-17 mm".

traits.leaf_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: leaves "pale green above, glaucescent beneath"; sRGB by eye from the photos (a dull blue-green).

traits.leaf_colour_autumn.note: Leaves turning red in autumn; sRGB by eye, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 93890682, 307832590, 4882217, 94886221, 306569656, 16293761, 385558788, 57549521): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "flowers solitary in the axils".

traits.flowering_position.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "flowers solitary in the axils".

traits.flower_posture.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: flowers "nodding on curved pedicels".

traits.corolla_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "corolla pinkish, 5-6 mm. long, subglobose"; read as urn-shaped, as the genus's (p. 327: "Corolla globose or ovoid and more or less urceolate").

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium deliciosum: "corolla pink, creamy pink, or red, globose to globular-urceolate, 4-6 x 5-7 mm"; Abrams (1951 p. 328): "5-6 mm. long".

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "corolla pinkish"; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "berries blue-black, with a bloom".

traits.fruit_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: berries "globose to pyriform".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium deliciosum: "Berries usually blue, glaucous ... 9-13 mm diam."; Abrams (1951 p. 328): "6-7 mm. in diameter", kept as the low.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "berries blue-black, with a bloom"; sRGB by eye from the photos, where the bloom shows them dusty blue.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Ripe berries in August and September, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 93890682, 307832590, 4882217, 94886221, 306569656, 16293761, 385558788, 57549521): the sources read give no count or measure.

generator.params.note: Red huckleberry's (vaccinium-parvifolium) values, changed by hand for Cascade blueberry: a low, densely branched shrub 1-3 dm high (Abrams 1951 p. 328), many stems from near the ground, short internodes, and single nodding flowers in the leaf axils. Not fitted to measurements.

appearance.organs.bloom.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium deliciosum: "flowers solitary in the axils, nodding"; "corolla pinkish, 5-6 mm. long, subglobose"; "berries blue-black, with a bloom, globose to pyriform, 6-7 mm. in diameter". Drawn as a pale pink urn a little smaller than the dusty blue berry. Resized 2026-10-19 to Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras): "Berries usually blue, glaucous ... 9-13 mm diam." and corolla "4-6 x 5-7 mm": the urn is 0.45 of the 11 mm berry.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a knee-high-or-lower carpet of blue-green, obovate leaves on green twigs, with pinkish urn-shaped flowers and dusty blue berries, flaming red in autumn. Organ cards from red huckleberry's (vaccinium-parvifolium), recoloured and resized by hand. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

allometry.note: 0.22 m tall at 10 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows in subalpine parkland. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium deliciosum: "Plants forming small clumps to extensive open colonies, 0.5-15 dm, rhizomatous".

traits.twig_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium deliciosum: "twigs green, sometimes glaucous, +/- terete"; sRGB a model estimate (confidence medium) of a dull, slightly glaucous green.

generator.params.bloom_size.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium deliciosum: "Berries ... 9-13 mm diam.": the bloom card is drawn as the ripe berry, 11 mm across, its flower look 0.45 of that (corolla "4-6 x 5-7 mm").
